data.gender_notes: Farzanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who cultivates a garden or gardens, keeping them in order and beauty. The name Farzanah carries the meaning “Gardener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farzanah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes growth, nurturing, and beauty in one's life.
data.etymology: Farzanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farzanah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فرزانہ
in_arabic.meaning: تَخَيُّل مُفَنَّنٌ، ذَاتَ فَهمٍ عَلى الَّذي يَخَيَّلَهُ
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفرزانة هي فَهم قويّ يَجري بِطَريقِ التَّخَيُّل وَيُشير إلى اِختِيارٍ مُبَرِزٍ وَإِصطِناعٍ مُفَنَّنٍ. يُشير هذا الاسم إلى مَن تَمتَع بِالذكاءِ وَالتَّفَكُّرِ، وَهُوَ مِنَ النّسَبِ اليَمنى، وَهِيَ مِنَ الاسماءِ العَليا الَّتي يُشير إلى الجَنَّةِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ النّسَبِ اليَمنى، وَهِيَ مِنَ الاسماءِ العَليا الَّتي يُشير إلى الجَنَّةِ.

in_urdu.name: فرزانہ
in_urdu.meaning: عقیلت سے مزید، جس کی فہم و عقلت ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرزانہ کا معنی ہے عقیلت سے مزید، جس کی فہم و عقلت ہو۔ یہ نام ہے ایک ایسے شخص کے لیے جو ذہانت و فہم کا مظہر ہو۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کا ہے اور اس کا تعلق عرب ادب اور اسلامی علوم سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़रज़ानह

Gardens have long been cherished in various cultures for their capabilities to offer tranquility, refreshment, and a place to enjoy nature. In the Islamic tradition, gardens hold a special place in both literature and poetry, often representing paradise or a oasis of peace and reflection.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name "Farzanah" holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of cultivating the self, both inwardly and outwardly. As a gardener tends to their plants, so too must we tend to our own souls, nurturing them with the wisdom of the Quran, the guidance of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and the practices of the Islamic faith. Just as a gardener must continuously water, prune, and care for their garden to keep it thriving, so too must we invest time and effort in developing our spiritual selves. The name "Farzanah" serves as a constant reminder of the beauty that can be found in the dedication to caring for oneself and one's environment, a reflection of the infinite beauty and mercy of Allah (swt).
